description: dMemo OpenCode plugin (T3.2) — in-process mem0-oss memory via @dmemo/core, every-turn injection, deterministic capture, native compaction-hook integration. Forked from mem0's opencode-mem0.ts (D18); mem0-Platform-only surfaces stripped.

detail.description_zh: dMemo OpenCode 插件 (T3.2) — 通过 @dmemo/core 提供进程内 mem0-oss 内存，每回合注入，确定性捕获，原生压缩钩子集成。从 mem0 的 opencode-mem0.ts (D18) 分叉；仅 mem0 平台表面已被移除。
